newsitem.title: USA: Jilin Chemical to issue 50 mln "A" shares.
newsitem.headline: Jilin Chemical to issue 50 mln "A" shares.

text.p: Jilin Chemical Industrial Co Ltd said Thursday it had received final approval from the Chinese Securities Regulatory Commission to issue 50 million "A" shares, expected to raise about 67 million yuan.
The company said the money is to be used to build facilities of its ethylene project and for working capital purposes.
Thirty million A shares are to be offered only to Chinese public investors at 3.50 yuan a share, while 20 million are to be placed with Jilin Chemical employees at the same price.

The shares will have the same rights as the company's "H" shares except that dividends will be paid in yuan. Holders of the A shares will be allowed to participate in the company's dividend distribution for this year, the company said.
The new A shares will represent about 1.5 percent of the company's expanded capital stock, Jilin Chemical said.

The 30 million A shares are to be fully underwritten by a syndicate of Chinese underwriters, with Zhong Xin Securities Co Ltd as the lead underwriter. The shares will be listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
The 20 million A shares placed with company employees are expected to be listed six months after the listing of the 30 million shares, the company said.
Jilin Chemical produces basic chemicals and chemical raw materials.
